title: Xirao's More Items and Blocks
description: This project added many compressed items and blocks to Minecraft.
body:
# Tips
This mod is currently in the testing phase and its content may be incomplete.

The following projects are not yet completed:

Compressed Block ,  Compressed Food,   Compressed Ore,   Compressed Enchantment Book.

# Supported versions and dependencies
This mod supports Minecraft version 1.21.1 using Fabric and depends on the Fabric API.

# Overview
This is a fabric mod, Added a lot of compressed items and blocks to Minecraft, all the way up to level 10. For example, a compressed wooden sword. Alternatively, you can take a look at the renderings.The damage or hardness of these items or blocks will increase as the level increases.

![Overview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5e9308e775d3d943e5f0719dc0fca78b0fedc30.png)

## About Crafting
In this mod, all items can be crafted by placing nine items of the next higher level on a crafting table.

# Level
The colors of multi-compressed items are shown below, arranged in order of compression level:

Level 1 Compressed : Grey         （HEX: #696969, RGB: 105, 105, 105）,

Level 2 Double     : Red          （HEX: #FF4B4B, RGB: 255, 000, 000）,

Level 3 Triple     : Orange       （HEX: #FF8C00, RGB: 255, 140, 000）,

Level 4 Quadruple  : Yellow       （HEX: #FFFF00, RGB: 255, 255, 000）,

Level 5 Quintuple  : Green        （HEX: #008000, RGB: 000, 128, 000）,

Level 6 Sextuple   : Blue         （HEX: #0000FF, RGB: 000, 000, 255）,

Level 7 Septuple   : Gold         （HEX: #FFD700, RGB: 255, 215, 000）,

Level 8 Octuple    : Indigo       （HEX: #4B0082, RGB: 075, 000, 130）,

Level 9 Nonuple    : Purple       （HEX: #800080, RGB: 128, 000, 128）,

Level 10 Tenfold   : purplish-red （HEX: #FF00FF, RGB: 255, 000, 255）.

# Q & A

Q1: Does this module support Forge or other mod loaders?
A1: No, the author has no plans to port it to other mod loaders at the moment.

Q2: This mod doesn't seem to have the limited content you described.
A2: Okay, go and take a look at the first part of the introduction yourself!

Q3: The textures in this mod look cheap.
A3: The author hasn't yet developed the talent for material design, and the development team for this mod consists of only one person. Things might get better in the future.

Q4: Will this mod be updated with every future Minecraft version update?
A4: No, it won't, but it will be updated with major mod versions. What are major mod versions? For example, versions 1.21.1, 1.20.1, and 1.12.2.
